to: Prof. Kiwon Song, Yonsei University, corresponding author of Choi et al., bioRxiv 2026.10.15.759291
why_recorded: These claims are now asserted to a third party, and the threshold manuscript rests on the same reanalysis. If any of them is wrong it has to be corrected to them as well as in the file.
claims_made: Converting their 48 h percentages back to rates undoes the saturation of 1 - exp(-lambda.t). The rate dependence is steep near wild-type charge and flattens: x8.3, x1.9, x1.8, x1.2 per two charge units across +2 to -6. Their straight line in percentage is therefore partly a property of the readout.
S266D/S273D against wild type is 5.5 % versus 0.6 %, which as a rate is 9.4-fold, with the charge-neutral S266A/S273A control flat. Two phosphomimetic substitutions sit on the steepest segment.

Their 3R-E time course gives hazards of 0.00463, 0.00500 and 0.00452 per hour at 12, 24 and 48 h -- constant to 4 % across a four-fold range -- which supports from kinetics the conclusion they argue from FRAP.
Their two q=0 constructs both show the hazard RISING about 2.5-fold between 48 and 72 h while q=-1 and q=-4 are flat or falling, which a lag appearing only where crossing is slow would produce.
Figure S5 panels E and F reassure on expression for the PAM and arginine series, but no serine construct appears in either, and those carry the phosphorylation argument and the largest rate effect.
Our reading reproduces their own mobile-fraction-against-charge statistic, R2 = 0.52 and P = 0.029 over nine constructs, which is offered as the check on the extraction.
what_was_disclaimed_in_the_email: That everything is read from their text rather than their data; that they are better placed to check it; that the 24-construct time course is their single-experiment dataset while the U2OS proportions have n=4 and the FRAP has per-structure n of 14 to 23; and that it is held loosely for that reason.

what_a_reply_would_change.if_they_share_the_source_data: The threshold manuscript's section 3.4 becomes a fit to real numbers with error bars rather than a reanalysis of prose-read percentages. The rising-hazard observation in the two slow constructs, which none of three models explains, could then be resolved as a lag, a subpopulation or heterogeneity -- the question the held-out test could not settle on five points.
what_a_reply_would_change.if_they_disagree: Their objection goes into the manuscript's limitations and to them in reply, and the numbers are rechecked against whatever they point at.
what_a_reply_would_change.if_no_reply: Nothing changes. The manuscript already states that the reanalysis rests on a single unreplicated experiment read from text, and that stands on its own.

corrections.status: Drafted 2026-10-28 in paper_private/email_song_draft.txt as a second email. DECIDED 2026-10-29 NOT TO SEND. The draft is kept as the record of what was found and what would have been written.
corrections.found_by: Checking the claims in this file against results/tdp43_charge_steps.json, which was written after the email went out and reports three measures of the scatter rather than one.

items.claimed: The 3R-E hazards are "constant to 4 %" across a four-fold range.
items.correct: The three rate constants were right. 4 % is their coefficient of variation, the smallest available description of the scatter. No single estimate is more than 6 % from the mean; the full range is 10 % of the mean.
items.effect_on_the_argument: None. The hazard is flat on all three measures, which is what the ageing argument needs.

items.correct: Flat as a percentage, and so scored by the authors, but about 1.5-fold above wild type once converted to a rate. The comparison is therefore S266D/S273D at 9.4-fold wild type and 6.3-fold the alanine control.
items.effect_on_the_argument: Weakens it slightly and leaves it standing: the phosphomimetic effect survives the controlled comparison at the same two positions.

corrections.both_are_the_same_error: A word accurate in the percentage domain carried unchanged into an argument conducted in rates, which is what the email itself was about.

decision_not_to_send.what_stands: Song holds the two figures as first sent: the 3R-E hazards as 'constant to 4 %' and the alanine control as 'flat'.
decision_not_to_send.what_was_corrected_anyway: Both are corrected in the manuscript. Section 3.4 now reads 'no estimate more than 6 % from the mean' and reports the alanine control at 1.5-fold wild type as a rate, giving 9.4-fold wild type and 6.3-fold the control.
decision_not_to_send.why_the_cost_is_limited: Neither correction touches Song's own measurements. Both concern how this reanalysis of his published percentages was described to him, and the published version of the reanalysis carries the corrected figures.
decision_not_to_send.noted_against_it: This file was created on the principle that claims asserted to a third party have to be corrected to them as well as in the file. That principle is not satisfied by this decision, and the record says so rather than leaving it to be inferred.

corrections.also_not_sent: The draft had gained a proposal that Song test N259D or N265D, the deamidation route his 15 charge constructs leave untouched. That proposal is unsent too. It survives as experiment 4 of the manuscript and in paper_private/sod1_cross_disease.md.
